name: runheed
description: Error tracking your coding agent can read: search production errors, read stack traces with context, fix the code and mark errors resolved.
suggestedPrompts: What broke in production since the last deploy? Fix the top error and resolve it with the commit hash
Show the stack trace and request for the newest unresolved error in this project
Did errors go up after yesterday's deploy? Compare the last 24 hours with the last 7 days
